newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK MARCH CORE INFLATION FIRMS TO 7.5PCT -ECON.
newsitem.headline: GREEK MARCH CORE INFLATION FIRMS TO 7.5PCT -ECON.

text.p: Greece's core consumer price inflation which does not include volatile food and energy prices rose to 7.5 percent year-on-year in March from 7.3 percent in February, an economist at a foreign bank told Reuters.
"It is obvious that there is an upward trend," he said.
Headline inflation dropped to 6.0 percent year-on-year in March from 6.6 percent in February.
Core inflation calculations were based on the revised CPI index and its sub-indices introduced by Greece's National Statistics Service (NSS) in early 1997.
NSS does not release core inflation figures but the central bank and the national economy ministry are known to monitor it. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
